name: Sipeed Longan Nano (GD32VF103CBT6)
description: Cheap RISC-V board with a 0.96-inch 160x80 IPS LCD, microSD slot, USB-C and GD32VF103CBT6 (108 MHz, 128 KB flash, 32 KB RAM, USB DFU) for about $5-6.
notes: Program over USB DFU (hold BOOT, tap reset, dfu-util) or the serial ISP; the 2x4 JTAG header needs a RISC-V debug probe. Supported by PlatformIO, Arduino-style cores and the GD32VF103 SDK.
Seeed's listing ($4.90) is marked discontinued; Sipeed's AliExpress store and other resellers still sell it. Some variants omit the LCD.
Board size is approximate (not stated on the Sipeed page); 28 GPIOs are led out to two pin headers.
